name: 师尊去哪了：变成神兽被五个徒儿rua秃 Taming My Fluffy Shizun
original_name: 师尊去哪了：变成神兽被五个徒儿rua秃 Taming My Fluffy Shizun
overview: Demon Lord Zane White failed to survive his Judgment Phase and was reborn as a powerless panda cub in Skyhaven Sect. Bound to the Tri-Realm Bond System, he needed his disciples' admiration to regain human form. Forced to act cute, he was spoiled by five female disciples. But actually, he humiliated Omni Sect, struck it rich, and dominated the sect tournament. When his identity was exposed, he led his disciples away from the false righteous path and founded Beastlord Sect. He gathered the five spirit orbs to fight the Immortal Emperor. His disciples sacrificed themselves to protect him, triggering the system's power, which shattered the Immortal Emperor's projection. In the end, he led the sect in ascension, but turned into an egg for a new journey.
